name: Appeals of automatic rulings go to a human
statement: An appeal against an automatic ruling is always reviewed by a human, who confirms or changes it (autonomy tier APPROVE), with the earlier ruling and its trace attached.

sources.quote: Organisations should define significant checkpoints or action boundaries that require human approval, especially before sensitive actions are executed.
You can appeal within 24 hours if you disagree with the outcome of your claim with any additional supporting evidence.
